bullets: • Name each displayed column; specify what data populates it, not how.
• State exact output format: percentages as whole numbers with '%' suffix.
• Define fallback text when data is absent, zero, or unqualified.
• Specify sort order: primary field direction, then tie-breaking field and direction.
• Assert one observable outcome per column, row, or conditional display state.
• Require percentage denominators and numerators: which stories, which field values qualify.
• Display '—' when metric lacks qualifying data; omit calculations for empty sets.
• Define exact message text for empty or unavailable data states.
• When AC references test_results, specify it is an array of {status, message} objects — check status === 'pass', never stringify the array.
